enemies.name: Seraphim
enemies.notes: Inflicts Paralysis, Confusion, Silence, Poison, Petrify, and Ring anomalies

bosses.name: Seraphim
bosses.strategy:
Seraphim hits pretty hard, enough to kill right off the bat, so once
again, Alice will be doing nothing but Arc this battle. Other than his
normal attacks, he will use Divine Punishment, doing pretty good damage
to your entire party, as well as causing various status effects, so make
sure to heal them straight away.

Have Yuri fuse into Amon and keep at him with physical attacks, and have
Margarete attack normally as well, taking breaks to help replenish MP and
SP as needed. Since Seraphim has lower HP than Cherubim, you probably
won't have to replenish either MP nor SP.

Like Cherubim, Seraphim isn't really that complicated, so as long as you
have Crucifixes equipped to everyone and have Alice use Arc every round,
then it's just a matter of taking the time to whittle away his HP. It
actually won't take nearly as long, since Seraphim only has 40% the HP
that Cherubim had.

NOTE     Once the battle is over, you'll receive Halley's best weapon,
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   the Volt Snipe.

  NOTE     To have access to this area, you must have read the Book of Rituals
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   in your Valuables menu to have it appear on the World Map.

Make your way into the Ruins and use the Save Point if you like. Go northeast
from here to enter the maze. Open the chest here for some [_ANGEL EARRINGS_],
then follow the paths in the following order, the color of the rainbow... sort
of. Each room will have a short path after it before you reach the next color
choice:

 - RED       (center room)
 - ORANGE    (right room, and yes, it looks yellow, but it really is orange.)
 - YELLOW    (left room)
 - GREEN     (center room)

 - In the next area where you can choose between turquoise, orange, and
   yellow, open the chest on the right for a [_LOTTERY TICKET_], then...

 - TURQUOISE (left room)
 - BLUE      (right room)
 - VIOLET    (right room)

You'll be back at the beginning, but the water will have drained and you can
now go downstairs. Descend the stairs and follow the path, opening the chest
for the [_GOLDTHREADCOAT_], Alice's best armor.

Make your way back upstairs, then examine the Book of Rituals in your Valuables
menu once again, which has changed. It now tells you to go backwards, so we'll
now follow the colors in reverse order:

 - VIOLET    (right room)
 - BLUE      (left room)
 - TURQUOISE (right room)
 - GREEN     (center room)
 - YELLOW    (right room)
 - ORANGE    (left room)
 - RED       (center room)

The water will drain once again, but to a different path this time. SAVE YOUR
GAME, make sure you have Crucifixes equipped, then when you're ready, descend
the stairs. This time, you'll have to face the freaky-looking Seraphim.
